declaration.preface:
This policy supersedes all the policies issued previously and all the subsequent amendments stand cancelled & substituted by this policy.

At Jay Finechem Private Limited, Our Labour and Human Rights Policy establishes a framework to uphold dignity, equality, and fairness in workplaces and communities. It aligns with international standards, including the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and International Labour Organization conventions, emphasizing fair wages, safe working conditions, and protection against discrimination and forced labour. This policy applies to all stakeholders employees, contractors, suppliers, and partners-promoting collaboration and accountability. By committing to ethical practices and fostering diversity and inclusion, we aim to balance business success with social responsibility, contributing to a global movement for fundamental labour and human rights and ensuring a fairer future for all.
declaration.declaration:
Ensure a safe work environment through health and safety measures and regular risk assessments. Provide training and resources to empower employees in prioritizing their well-being.

Guarantee fair wages, reasonable hours, and humane conditions in line with labor laws. Promote continuous improvement in workplace standards for employee satisfaction.

Foster open communication between employees and management through consultations and feedback. Support freedom of association and collective bargaining rights.

Offer professional growth opportunities through training and skill development. Cultivate a culture of lifelong learning to empower employees.

Strictly prohibit child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking within the organization and supply chain. Implement monitoring mechanisms to eliminate such practices.

Promote a diverse workplace that values all individuals and ensures equitable access to opportunities. Foster an environment of mutual respect and collaboration.
declaration.scope: This Labor and Human Rights Policy applies to all individuals associated with Jay Finechem Private Limited, including employees, contractors, workers, suppliers, and business partners. We collectively share the responsibility to uphold labor and human rights standards, ensuring a respectful and equitable environment for all. The policy applies to all of our sites.

focusAreas: Prevention of Child Labor, Forced Labour, and Human Trafficking

Occupational Health & Safety: Plan for expand mental health resources by establishing wellness hubs and providing access to licensed professionals.
Train all employees on health and safety guidelines.
Conduct monthly safety drills to reinforce preparedness and response mechanisms.
Plan for monthly emergency response procedures and safety signage training.
Introduce advanced safety equipment and technology to minimize risks in high-stakes work environments.
Conduct awareness and ergonomic training programs to prevent Repetitive Strain Injuries (RSI) and reduce workplace stress among employees.
Workplace Conditions & Well beings: Develop a comprehensive workplace wellness program focusing on physical, mental, and financial well-being.
We ensure all eligible employees are covered under the Employee State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) scheme, while those not eligible receive Mediclaim coverage for their healthcare.
We will continue promoting a balanced and fulfilling lifestyle through mindfulness, well-being, and personal growth, ensuring all employees are covered under the Art of Living scheme.
Establish green and ergonomic workspaces to promote a sustainable and comfortable environment.

Ensure fair and timely payment of wages, salaries, and employee benefits in compliance with applicable labour laws, including the Payment of Wages Act, 1936, Minimum Wages Act, 1948, and Code on Wages, 2019.
Maintain compliance with all applicable workplace and labour regulations related to employee welfare, occupational health & safety, working conditions, social security, and employee rights.
Employee Engagements & Social Dialogue: Launch an internal social platform to facilitate communication and collaboration among employees.
Create a structured employee suggestion system with recognition and implementation programs for innovative ideas.

We aim to conduct regular town hall meetings with internal stakeholders to strengthen employees' knowledge of updated documents and to ensure management is aware of any complaints or concerns raised by employees.
Strengthen the existing employee representative system to enhance employee participation, ensure their voices are heard, and address their concerns.
Career Development and Training Programs: Introduce a Company-wide learning Management System with tailored courses for employees at all Levels. (Record of External Training to be Maintained)
Partners with Leading Education System to provide Advanced training and Certification Programs (Hiring for Premier Institute like IIT/ICT)
Develop personalized career plans for employees, outlining clear growth paths and skill development.
Implement regular performance reviews to assess progress, provide feedback, and align individual goals with company objectives.
Conduct leadership development and managerial skill enhancement programs to prepare employees for future leadership roles within the organization.
Encourage continuous learning by providing employees access to technical workshops, soft skills training, cross-functional learning opportunities, and industry seminars/conferences.
Prevention of Child Labor, Forced Labour: Maintain a zero-tolerance approach towards labour exploitation, child labour, forced labour, discrimination, harassment, and any unethical employment practices across the organization and supply chain.
Conduct Audits and Assessment internally as well as with suppliers to assess Compliance with ethical Labour Practices.
Roll out awareness campaigns and training programs for employees, suppliers, and stakeholders on ethical labor practices.
Establish a centralized whistleblower hotline for reporting unethical practices confidentially.
Implement blockchain technology to enhance transparency and traceability across the supply chain.
Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, human rights standards, and international ethical sourcing principles throughout business operations and supplier networks.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Initiat: Ensure equal opportunity without discrimination in recruitment, promotion, and compensation, fostering a fair and inclusive environment where all employees have access to the same opportunities, regardless of age, gender, religion, race, or background.
Partner with organizations specializing in DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion) to enhance recruitment strategies.
Conduct regularly diversity Audits to measure Progress and refine polices for equitable outcomes.
Organize awareness sessions, sensitization workshops, and inclusion training programs to promote respect, cultural understanding, and unconscious bias mitigation across the workplace.
Encourage the formation of employee engagement and support groups to promote collaboration, representation, and an inclusive workplace culture for diverse employee groups.
Discrimination and Harassment: We maintain a strict zero-tolerance policy towards all forms of discrimination and harassment in the workplace.
A culture of respect, fairness, and inclusion will be cultivated across all levels of the organization to proactively prevent any form of discrimination or harassment.
Regular training and awareness programs on discrimination and harassment will be implemented to ensure that all employees understand their rights and the company's policies.
Clear and accessible channels for reporting discrimination or harassment will be established, providing employees with a safe platform to voice concerns without fear of retaliation.
Diversity and inclusion principles will be incorporated into recruitment, training, and performance evaluation processes to reduce unconscious bias.
Discrimination and harassment policies will be reviewed and strengthened annually to ensure they remain up to date with the latest legal standards and best practices.

Aim to continue conducting biannual town halls and leadership Q&A sessions, which began in 2022.

Our goal is to cover 100% of employees in collective bargaining sessions by 2030, starting from the 2022 baseline.
Form an employee representative committee in every location by 2030.

Aim to provide performance evaluations for 100% of employees by 2030, starting from the baseline in 2022.
Achieve a 10% increase in employee skill certifications by 2030 compared to 2022 levels.

policy.monitoring:
A yearly evaluation will be conducted to measure the effectiveness of our labor and human rights strategies. Findings will guide future actions and improvements.

We will monitor and disclose essential metrics related to fair wages, working conditions, diversity, inclusion, and workplace rights. This data will support continuous progress and highlight areas needing attention.

Regular audits and assessments will be conducted, with corrective actions taken as needed.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Executive Director will conduct an annual review of the Labor and Human Rights Policy to assess its effectiveness, compliance with regulatory requirements, and alignment with best practices.
